title: The Undertow of Anderlecht
author: Ansel Galloway
blurb: Casper Underhill, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
